articleTitle: Towards a Conceptual Model of a Blockchain System for Automatic Generation of Academic Diplomas: Use Cases and Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The implementation of a blockchain system for the automatic generation of academic credentials in a higher education institution can be considered as a safeguard against potential instances of abuse and counterfeiting of diplomas. However, the utilization of blockchain technology in the field of education, particularly within higher education institutions, appears to be limited in scope. This article aims to elucidate the advantages and constraints associated with the use of blockchain technology in higher education organizations. In addition, we present the ideas towards developing a blockchain-based prototype model that targets the automatic generation of diplomas using smart contracts and ensures the fast and secure verification of diplomas. In order to provide a more comprehensive understanding of the blockchain system, we aim to expand on its description via the use of graphical representations in the form of use case diagrams for each actor involved in the system. Additionally, we provide use case scenarios, as well as outline the functional as well as the nonfunctional requirements that are essential for the proper functioning of such a system.

articleTitle: Data Transmission in Automated Mining Quarry Management
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Modern broadband communication systems equipped with high-precision location determination systems are actively used for the efficient data transmission in mining quarries management. This article presents an analysis of a specific example of using automated systems to manage mining quarries, where various wireless data transmission technologies are employed. The experience gained from implementing wireless technologies for real-time control of earth-moving and construction machinery in mining quarries can be valuable in the implementation of similar projects for vehicle management in other industries.

articleTitle: Regression Analysis for Predicting Health Insurance
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In the field of health care, the use of data for medical insurance is a current area of research. In this report, regression models created using machine learning methods and algorithms for health insurance prediction are the object of investigation. A correlation analysis was performed on the input data, and a strong dependence was found for the features BMI and smoker. A comparative analysis was made for twenty-four models constructed using Decision Trees (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Boosted, and Bagged algorithms. To evaluate the model metrics were used the coefficient of determination (R-Squared), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Time for training. From the obtained experimental results, it is found that the model for the BMI feature with the Bagged algorithm has an accuracy of 0.94. The mean squared error for features Smoker and Blood Pressure of models created with the Bagged algorithm is 0.06. Models built with the Support Vector Method (SVM) require more training time than the others do. Algorithms from machine learning and statistical analysis are used to create regression models that can be useful both for health care providers and to improve the services provided.

articleTitle: A Fast Algorithm for Estimating the Voltage Deviation of the Nodes of an Electrical Power System with Longitudinal Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The problem of optimal placement of reactive power compensation (RTC) devices in the power supply system (EPS) is considered. An algorithm for determining the location of the RPC installation in the power grid (EPN) is proposed, based on the choice of devices that provide the greatest EPS coverage and allow creating the maximum effect on the voltage deviation in the nodes. The reactive power consumed by the devices is used as an economic criterion for comparing the installation options of RPC devices. Since this parameter reflects the cost of the device. The stress deviation in the EPN nodes is determined by means of relations obtained using the bilinear theorem (BT). This approach will reduce the time and financial costs of finding a solution to the problem. Since having functional ratios, it is not necessary to calculate the mode for the entire system, it is enough to use the ratio between a specific node and the line in which compensation is performed. A unique algorithm was also proposed for determining the distance between nodes along the length of the graph using the incidence matrix, which allows you to determine the nodes associated with the regulated line without using EPN graphics.

articleTitle: An Approach for Providing Mobile Connectivity in Hard to Access Rugged Terrain
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: People are used to have mobile coverage on their phones anytime, anywhere. The fact is, however, that there are relatively urbanized areas that present an incredible difficulty in ensuring mobile connectivity. Similar problems are also found in urban environments between different buildings that form "radio shadows", but there the problem is easily overcome with minimal investment. Another issue is a similar problem caused, not by tall buildings but by mountain ranges, where even if there is a base station built near the area, its relief significantly worsens the coverage. The paper presents a useful approach for providing mobile connectivity in hard-to-reach areas.

articleTitle: Model of Controlled Environment based on Blockchain and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, automated remote monitoring of environmental conditions is based on the use of IoT sensors controlled by various wireless technologies. Registering the moment of occurrence of unwanted and unexpected events is extremely important, both for taking adequate actions to limit the damage and for proving the responsibility of certain employees, but also for presenting an insurance claim to the insurance company with irrefutable evidence. This paper presents a model and solution based on HyperLedger blockchain and IoT sensor network integrating BLE, LoRa and ZigBee technologies. The presented studies prove the applicability of the proposed model and the advantages it offers - trust, transparency, security, visibility and role-based access to all participants in the business network.

articleTitle: Study of Computer Vision for Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In recent years, computer vision technology has made significant progress, expanding its application from simple image recognition tasks to complex real-world problems. One such area where computer vision promises to be is the control of manipulators in various fields such as manufacturing, healthcare and robotics. Manipulators, mechanical arms designed to perform tasks, are traditionally controlled using manual input or a preprogrammed sequence. The purpose of this manuscript is to research and analyze computer vision applicable to improve the control and efficiency of manipulators.

articleTitle: Using GPT-3 to Automatically Create RESTful Service Descriptions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: There exists a problem of the lack of machine-readable description for most web services that are used today. Most of these services are RESTful services and often do not have formally defined functionality. The aim of this paper is to solve this problem through the automatic generation of descriptions of these services. The practical part of the work includes the application of GPT-3 model for the automatic generation of RESTful web service descriptions through several examples of available application programming interfaces.

articleTitle: A Simple Driver for Series-Connected IGBT’s
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The article presents a scheme and principle of operation of a simple driver for controlling series-connected IGBTs for applications where the duty cycle of the control pulses does not exceed 50 %. The driver is characterized by the presence of few elements in the final stages, without introducing additional feedback and adjustment loops, using modern magnetic materials. Schemes and computer simulation results are presented. Here are shown the oscillograms of the control pulses for four transistors at different duty cycles as well as during the switch on and off edges.

articleTitle: Energy Characteristic Analyses of Waste Wood Pellets
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In the presented study, some of the most important energy characteristics which mainly affect the efficiency of the combustion process in domestic combustion installations, have been experimentally determined and analyzed. To do that, measurements of experimental samples were performed. These samples were made of waste wood in the form of dust, granules and pellets for domestic use, on which the calorific value (CV), ash content (AC) and moisture content (MC) were determined. The experimental samples were made of coniferous (white pine and spruce) and deciduous (beech and oak) wood. The necessary quality standards relevant to the study are also discussed. After measuring and processing the data from the results, a comparative analysis was made between the studied samples and standard norms. It was found that the studied energy characteristics of all wood samples correspond to the norms in the standards.

articleTitle: Land Cover Segmentation using DeepLabV3 and ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Land cover segmentation has a great importance in various fields, including remote sensing, environmental monitoring, urban planning, agriculture, and natural resource management. It involves a division process of a landscape or region into different classes or categories with respect to the type of land cover in each place. With the recent developments in remote sensing area, high-resolution satellite images can be simply acquired. For an efficient land cover segmentation, in this study, a hybrid approach using deep learning architectures DeepLabV3 and ResNet34 is proposed. The proposed method has been trained and tested using the LandCover AI dataset. As a result, 88.2% F1-score value was obtained with the proposed hybrid approach.

articleTitle: Database Normalization via Nonrepeating Groups: A Comparative Methodological Approach by Lemmas
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This research proposes an approach that uses nonrepeating groups as the basis for decomposing relations. A repeating group refers to a column or set of columns that have duplicated data values. The typical process of normalization begins with the identification of repeating groups but instead of using these to drive the process, the researchers propose the use of the complement of repeating groups, the nonrepeating groups from the Unnormalized Form (UNF) through First Normal Form (1NF). The rest of the stages, from the Second Normal Form (2NF) through Third Normal Form (3NF) will follow the usual normalization flow. As part of the process, four lemmas shall be introduced at different stages and conveniently to facilitate the forward-bound, efficient flow of the process. The result is a normalization process whose intermediate stages and steps may differ from those typical of a repeating group-driven process albeit the final resultant, relational structures shall be comparable to those yielded via repeating groups approach. Should the nonrepeating group approach yield similar results as a repeating group-driven approach, the term normalization equivalence could be used i.e., if a relation normalized via repeating groups yields a similar result set as a nonrepeating group process, then the two approaches are said to be normalization equivalent. Otherwise, there is normalization inequivalence.

articleTitle: VANET Framework for Incident Response and Management
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: With the increasing number of vehicles on the roads, communication between them has become an area of exploration, standardisation, and development. Vehicular Adhoc Network (VANET) constitutes a network that connects vehicles and ensures intelligent traffic control and real-time information exchange. Various frameworks are employed in VANET to enhance communication and security within the road infrastructure. This study presents a VANET framework for incident response and management, utilising the technologies of Blockchain, Fog, and Cloud computing. The proposed framework aims to track data related to road conditions, incident detection and ensuring data authenticity, notifying emergency stations and insurers about occurred incidents, and analysing archived data.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Benefits from the Use of Sparse Updates Techniques in Reinforcement Learning: Experimental Simulations in Complex Action Space Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive exploration of the advantages associated with the utilization of sparse update techniques in Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) within the context of Reinforcement Learning (RL). The study leverages simulations with environments featuring complex action spaces and wide state spaces, characterized by state vectors of dimension 128 and a choice of 9 distinct actions. The research investigates the impact of different update frequencies in ANNs when applied to RL agents in these simulation environments. The experimental methodology entails testing ANN updates after each action executed by the RL agent, followed by evaluations at progressively less frequent intervals. To assess the effectiveness of these techniques, several critical attributes are compared across simulations. These attributes encompass the collected rewards by the RL agents, the number of actions required to accomplish specific tasks within the complex environments, and the computation time necessary to achieve task completion. The study reveals that the optimal update frequency for RL agents using ANNs varies depending on the specific simulation environment. Some environments benefit from more frequent updates, while others perform better with fewer updates. However, excessively sparse updates can lead to performance drops. These findings emphasize the importance of adaptable update schedules tailored to each RL task, which can significantly enhance RL algorithm design in complex environments with wide action and state spaces.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Main Engineering and Production Chains in the SMART Factory
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The current study defines and reviews the major engineering-and-production chains in a contemporary Smart factory. The research goes through three main stages - review of the core definitions of the “Smart factory” concept and generating a working definition for the purposes of the present article, synthesis of the major engineering-and-production chains in a contemporary Smart factory and analysis of their structure and functional correlation. The chain “human machine - robot - machine - human” is outlined as a fundament of the other chains, which determine the architecture of the Smart factory. At the same time, this chain is ensured by the engineering-and-technological chain “software - hardware - sensors - robotized and automated production capacities - sensors - hardware - software”. The six major engineering-and-production chains are brought forward on this basis and are analytically studied: “resource planning - resource provision”, “available resources production planning - production capacity planning - control over the production power capacities”, “production planning production processes planning - operational production control over the production processes and operations”, “strategic control - operational-and-production control”, “production processes - quality testing - production-and-management software - operational-and-production software”, and, “quality testing - transportation-and-trade logistics”, which determine the generation of new business, management and production models.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Key Generation Algorithms used in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Blockchain is a technology that is constantly improving. The encryption algorithms that are used in the blockchain are of particular importance for its security. In the present work, the various algorithms for encryption and key generation - RSA, ECC, EdDSA, and hash functions - are considered. A comparative analysis of the algorithms was made. A survey of cryptographic algorithms was made in terms of message size, hash value size, and security. Each of the algorithms plays an important role in creating secure keys and improving security in blockchain networks. Depending on the desired degree of security and available hardware setup, each of the algorithms has its applicability.

articleTitle: Integrating Hydrogen Production Capacity in the Energy Transition: Energy Efficiency and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The energy transition in Europe and the expansion of electricity transmission has suffered many delays, despite its importance for the integration of renewable electricity. A hydrogen grid that reuses the existing gas grid can not only help meet the demand for low-emission fuels, but also balance the differences in wind and solar power on the continent and thus avoid grid expansion. The paper deals with integration of an existing hydrogen production plant into the energy system as part of technical solutions for energy storage.

articleTitle: Concept for an Electronic System for Control of the Drying Process in a Spray Dryer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: One of the key objectives in drying processes is to ensure the quality of the drying material. This study presents the development of a concept of an electronic system for controlling a spray dryer, that is based on the energy and mass balance of the process. Initially the criteria for controlling the drying material parameters are defined, aimed at preventing the denaturation of the drying material. Next the study presents the algorithm of the electronic system, summarizing the decision-making process. The key input and output data flows are summarized with a block diagram. The study also presents the structure of an electronic system for controlling the drying process in spray dryer. It consists of three microcontrollers that communicate wirelessly. They collect raw data using three types of sensors and control the process with the use of four types of actuators. The algorithmic background of the proposed electronic system allows to ensure the required quality of the drying material, using the energy and mass balance of the drying process.

articleTitle: A Robotic Camera for Surveying of Sewer Collectors
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a low cost robotic radio-controlled platform for monitoring of sewer collectors. The development is carried out based on the respective requirements that it must meet. The platform is driven by appropriate brushless direct current motors with electronic commutation. The presented system can be controlled from a console in a van or by radio control and has the possibility of wirelessly transmitting a video image to a monitor also located in the van. Practical studies have been carried out and experimental results are presented and discussed. After the tests held and the respective results analyzed, some improvements have been made. The described robotic system can be used to carry out sewer inspections and to locate some accidents.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Possibilities of using a Hybrid Drive System with a Methanol-fueled Fuel Cell Dedicated to the Operational Conditions of the Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The issue of implementing new drive system solutions is closely related to the cost of the components of these systems. This is particularly reflected in drive systems that are intended to use fuel cells. They constitute a significant cost in the overall context of the production cost of the vehicle’s drive system. Therefore, ways are being sought to introduce solutions that will be modern and, at the same time, their cost will be acceptable to the market of potential buyers. Therefore, the personalization of drive systems according to market needs is necessary. Such a solution has been developed, and its most important assumptions and effects are presented in this article.

articleTitle: Ecological Impact versus Energy Generation by Floating Photovoltaic Power Plant for a Small Romanian Lake
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The development of floating photovoltaic systems in Romania can help to the share of more than 30.7 % of the total energy produced from renewable energy sources set for the year 2030. Floating photovoltaic plants ensure the achievement of overall energy targets without affecting biodiversity and/or agricultural crops. This study evaluates the insolation and the possibility of installing this technology on Lake Făcău, Romania, to benefit from the generation of electricity but also better water quality and reduction of carbon dioxide emissions $\left(\mathrm{CO}_{2}\right)$. The obtained results are promising as Floating photovoltaic plants covering around 0.22 % of the lake surface, provide 26.76 $M W h /$ year and the estimated reduction of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission is 7.52 $\mathbf{t C O}_{2 \mathrm{eq}} /$ year.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Drastic T-norm on Two Fuzzy- Rough Rule Induction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Algorithms are widely used for knowledge discovery, and due to the variety of different problem types, there is no single algorithm that solves all problems. Therefore, different types of algorithms have been developed and one of these groups is the fuzzy-rough rule algorithms. In this direction, the paper aims to improve the output performance of the algorithm models by introducing a new norm, in this case the Drastic T-norm. This norm is important because it is part of the various key components of the fuzzy rough algorithms, the lower and upper approximations. To examine the influence of the Drastic T-norm on multiple data sets with different numbers of attributes and instances and from different disciplines, we conducted several experiments in which we used four fuzzy tolerance relationship metrics and a comparison with Einstein T-norms. The results of the experimental evaluation came to the conclusion that, in addition to some improvements that the drastic T-norm provided for some data sets, there were also data sets whose models were inferior compared to the previously used T-norm. Building on this, our future work will focus on examining the influence on other elements of the induction process, such as weak measurements and implicators.

articleTitle: Implementation and Analysis of a Customized Encryption Algorithm in 5G Networks for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The security of 5G networks includes a combination of encryption, authentication and access control mechanisms to protect data and ensure the integrity and confidentiality of communication. Encryption, such as AES, plays an important role in protecting the privacy and integrity of data transmitted over 5G networks. The purpose of the paper is to design a custom encryption algorithm for educational purposes and to present a more detailed implementation that follows the AES specification exactly. The design of a custom AES encryption algorithm with implementation of AES-128 encryption in Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode and key expansion can be considered as the main contribution and achieved result. For the purpose of the task, we used the pycryptodome library and created a Python script for AES-128 encryption.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Frameworks for Parking Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: A wide variety of open-source libraries and platforms support the creation of machine learning models that provide ready-to-use implementations of many popular algorithms available under various licenses. Such software frameworks reduce the time and effort of researchers and developers engaged in different projects where there is a need to use specific machine learning techniques. Case-based reasoning (CBR) involved in Parking Guidance Information System (PGIS) uses k-nearest neighbor (kNN) classification as well as several other machine learning methods in the various stages of building the action plan. In this analysis, we explore free toolkit options that can meet the needs of a specific input data system. We also consider additional requirements for efficient indexing and optimization of use cases, aiming to reduce the need for multiple programming languages and platforms and coding algorithms from scratch.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality in Creating Added Value for an ERP System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Augmented reality (AR) is one of technologies that lately brings its potential to society. At the same time, all the positive features brought by digital transformation and industry 4.0 are trying to be united in order to create even more added value to a business. Since ERP systems are the foundation of every business, research into the application of augmented reality in the context of ERP systems has great importance and represents an interesting scientific and practical problem. In addition to identifying benefits, opportunities, limitations and application area of using augmented reality in ERP systems this paper also presents one proof of concept (PoC) scenario implementing an augmented reality mobile application for showing 3D models through which extended functionality of ERP system can be achieved and new business value can be created. During development, methodological approach based on extreme programming (XP) was used.

Author Keywords: application of AR in ERP systems

articleTitle: Statistical Evaluation of Classification Models for PCA Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: A successful strategy to eavesdrop on the information exchange of legitimate users is by implementing a pilot contamination attack (PCA) during the process of channel estimation. Detection of such an intrusion can be accomplished at the BS and two promising methods that can be used for this purpose are 2-N-PSK and Shifted 2-N-PSK. As binary classification models, in this paper, the performance of both methods can be best evaluated through several commonly used statistical metrics, including statistical accuracy, precision and recall, specificity, fall-out and F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-score. Other useful information can be obtained from the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and the ROC Area Under Curve (AUC) that represent the trade-off between fall-out and recall. For the purpose of comparing the performance of 2-N-PSK and Shifted 2-N-PSK, in this paper each of the aforementioned metrics is extensively studied, and simulation results are provided and analyzed.

articleTitle: Structural Analysis of a PLC Controller based Industrial Application
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The variety of contemporary industrial control systems challenges the idea of complexity. Principles of regulation extend over pneumatic, hydraulic and electronic means. The current study is an example of the fore mentioned. Despite the description of an already implemented system, provisioned to ensure effective control on the technological process for assembly of nipple-nut joints, a comprehensive structural analysis is included herein, based on the theory of logical gates. It serves the signaling mechanism of the system, regulated by a PLC controller and refers to its optional expansion in terms of more and adequate input/output signals.

articleTitle: Conceptual Database Framework for Multicriteria Decision of the Donations Logistics and Disasters Relief in Smart Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In earthquakes where large-scale destructions occur, there are problems in water and electricity distribution for a period of time. It is also known that even if mains water distribution is provided, water consumption is not reliable due to the destruction experienced. Especially for people who do not leave the earthquake zone for various reasons right after the earthquake, finding water and food is an important problem in the first days. In order to alleviate this problem, it would be a logical approach to keep a certain amount of aid parcels in earthquake zone settlements. However, in this case, the perishable nature of food and beverage items appears as an obstacle. In this study, both post-earthquake relief efforts and poverty aid efforts were combined through the preparation of aid boxes and the evaluation of the expiration dates of the materials and a conceptual framework that covers both poverty and disaster relief is proposed. A simulation study was conducted to illustrate the operability of the model.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of a Line-Start Synchronous Reluctance Motor with Mixed Stator Winding Configurations
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents the performance analysis of a line-start synchronous reluctance motor (LSSynRM) with mixed stator winding configurations for transient capabilities. Conventional double-layer (CDL) winding arrangements of the stator winding adopted from the induction motors are usually used in most LSSynRMs. In this paper a contrast is drawn between the LSSynRM with CDL winding arrangement and LSSynRMs with double layer with coil sides shifted (DLCS) to a foreign zone and double triple layer (DTL) winding arrangements, as pertained to their transient performance. The rotor of the LSSynRM reported in this paper has two flux barriers per pole that accommodate thick copper bars short-circuited by end rings. The Finite element method (FEM) is used to model and design the LSSynRM to study the performance of key electromagnetic parameters. Experimental measurements validate the finite element analysis (FEA) results. The results indicate that the winding arrangement with DTL has better transient capabilities than those with CDL and DLCS.

articleTitle: Challenges to the Application and Decision-Making using Artificial Intelligence (AI): Analysis of the Attitudes of Managers in Bulgarian Service Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Modern business requires the application of artificial intelligence (AI), which comes to the aid of the human factor, as it exceeds the abilities and capabilities of company employees to simultaneously perform a set of tasks with large data arrays and information. Increasingly, AI assists managers to make management and business decisions so as to support their work, optimize business processes and increase the competitiveness of companies. However, questions arise that in one way or another limit or question the fine line regarding the useful and rational use of AI and the dangers and challenges in a corporate environment. These circumstances will depend on the company's approach to AI, available resources and understanding of its importance to business practice. This publication aims to identify key challenges to the use and decision-making through AI, by conducting a survey of the attitudes of managers in Bulgarian service companies.

articleTitle: Architecture of Modern E-Learning Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Abstract-In contemporary educational institutions, a robust Learning Management System (LMS) plays an important role within the E-Learning infrastructure. An LMS serves as an organized repository for course materials while also incorporating vital communication features like discussion forums, annotations, and chats. The LMS encompasses tools designed to monitor students’ advancement through course materials and assess the knowledge they acquire during their learning journey. Since the LMS is a complex software application, which operates for extended periods of time, it needs a careful consideration of its design in terms of functionality, dependability, and lifecycle management. In this paper, we present the architecture of a modern LMS called WBT-Master. This architectural framework is referred to as CDAT, representing Controller, Data, Activity, and Template. The "Activity" assumes a central role within the application. It processes the incoming data according to its designated purpose, and visualizes the data on the user’s screen. The “Template” element comprises HTML fragments containing placeholders The placeholders are bound to the activity variables. “Controllers” act as event handlers and load the different activities depending on user actions. “Data Provider” offer a unified data representation on diverse data sources. We also explore the system’s data organization principles and its seamless integration with popular cloud services.

articleTitle: Data Protection during Hardware-software Mobile Signal Transmission of Earth-moving and Construction Machines' Sensors in Multiservice Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper discusses the factors affecting data security transmitted from earthmoving and construction machines sensors' in multiservice networks. Various methods for data protection, their strengths and weaknesses are considered. Authors analyzed trends in this area and developed their own algorithm for searching for software bookmarks in telecommunication equipment code to exclude using ones in order to gain data access by equipment suppliers and third parties. The paper presents results of software testing from various manufacturers for Linux and Windows operating systems using several existing analyzers and the developed system. Assessment of the time spent on searching for vulnerabilities using the developed subsystem and other searching tools is given.

articleTitle: High Isolation Dual Port MIMO Antenna for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This research paper reports a very thin 2-port multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna with a small footprint of $14\times 10\times 0.58\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m}^{3}$. The proposed design works between the frequencies of 8.73 to 15.86 GHz. A modified hexagonal patch is used along with the defected ground plane to obtain wide bandwidth. A conventional decoupling strip technique is utilized to improve the isolation between the ports and it is found >19dB across the whole operating band. In addition to that, 'H'-shaped slot has been incorporated into the grounding plane to enhance impedance matching. The realized gain and radiation patterns of the designed antenna are calculated and found quite acceptable. Furthermore, the diversity parameters of the antenna are computed with envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) <0.025 and diversity gain (DG) is found >9.97dB across the entire operating frequency range. Finally, the results of MIMO antenna are compared with the calculated data for the purpose of practical validation.

articleTitle: Experimental Comparison of Standard and Trajectories Movement Algorithm using Intelligent Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: With the development of technology, mobile transport robotic systems are increasingly entering various industries. The wide range of movement capabilities of a mobile transport robot with omnidirectional wheels around its central vertical axis and the precision of its movements in small spaces is an important advantage in terms of its controllability when used in logistics warehouses, industrial and production premises. For this reason, it is necessary to use complex algorithms for navigation in transport robots, which can be created with specific tools like Robotic Operating System (ROS) and others similar to it. The aim of the paper is to compare experimentally standard and trajectories movement algorithm using intelligent camera. The achieved results show that for 82.4% of the time the movement accuracy of the AGV is in accordance with the ideal trajectory. From the measurements made for the time to pass the route and the obtained average speed of movement, we can elect the conclusion that, when applying an algorithm using an artificial intelligence camera to determine the upcoming movement trajectory, we get a higher speed of movement and more stable trajectories compared, to a standard trajectories algorithm.

articleTitle: Applications of 3D Printing in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Advances in 3D printing have brought that technology into the smooth and easy creation of extremely complex shapes. The paper, therefore, presents a complete overview of the various possibilities of the practical implementation of 3D printing for the purposes of precision agriculture. Developed, through that technology, is a housing for the soil moisture sensor system. The sensor underwent rigorous testing for a period of three months and demonstrated excellent operational performance, with the material from which it is made exhibiting great strength and resilience to the variability in the specific agro-climatic conditions. Built, additionally, was a stand capable of accommodating four multispectral drone cameras. Achieved, as a result, was optimal strength with minimum weight in view of the specific volume to be filled up. The technology, hereto described, shows great promise as an environmentally friendly approach to the construction of intricate shapes.

articleTitle: Danube River Monitoring, Information and Advising System for Pollution Prevention and Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper focuses on the development of an artificially intelligent information and communication technology and a sensor-based emergency risk management tool for pollution prevention and water quality control of the Danube River in the section of the river between Romania and Bulgaria. The article includes guidelines for risk management related to river pollution and water quality, which expands the scope of possible interventions beyond those currently considered. The expanded range of interventions includes tasks that are currently too difficult to engage human involvement, tasks where access may not be possible without information and communication technology and sensor support, tasks where such support would significantly increase speed, accuracy or the set of tasks/sensors, especially when sampling significant events of toxicity/radiation/pollution, man-made and natural disasters and other relevant hazard situations or combinations of hazards. As a secondary focus, the application of the proposed method among the municipalities along the Danube River will contribute to the sustainable use and protection of water resources in both Romania and Bulgaria, which on the other hand will support the protection and restoration of biodiversity and ecosystems.

articleTitle: Design of Educational Model of Full 4-bit Adder and Subtractor
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The article describes in detail the design of a 4-bit adder and subtractor. We will design the necessary sub-blocks for its proper functioning, such as a 2-bit multiplexer and a complete 1-bit adder and subtracter. We will show how to determine the propagation delay of the designed electronic circuit.

articleTitle: An Artificial Neural Network Model to Forecast Grain Crops in North-Kazakstan Agricultural Experimental Station
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper analyzes and predicts the yield of grain crops of LLP “North-Kazakhstan Agricultural Experimental Station” for the last 30 years. The class of artificial neural networks-multilayer perceptron (MLP) was used as a research tool. The process of training of a model of a neural network consisting of 30 networks was performed on the basis of 70% training and 30% control samples. Based on the analysis of residuals histogram and scatter plot of the target and output function, the best neural network models MLP-1-7-1 (p=0.92), MLP-1-8-1 (p=0.97), MLP-1-5-1 (p=0.82) were selected. Next, using the best MLP 1-8-1 network, the model was tested the given data. Using time series projection, a graph was illustrated and a table of predicted grain yield values for the coming years was tabulated. The absolute error showed the high accuracy of the obtained best MLP 1-8-1 network for forecasting the amount of grain crop yield. The obtained model of artificial network can be applied in research and monitoring of agricultural production development.

articleTitle: Address Generation and Transaction Simulation in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The encryption algorithms that are used in the blockchain are of particular importance for its security. In the current development, the different algorithms for encryption, generation of keys and addresses for secure data transfer, and carrying out transactions in wallets are considered. Two main algorithms for generating addresses in blockchain are considered - RSA and DGK. Tests have been made to generate reliable addresses under different input parameters for both algorithms. The research was done with the Cryptool software product.

articleTitle: Automatic Color Pattern Recognition for Ribbonized Multifiber Optic Cables
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to showcase an algorithm for the automatic color pattern recognition of a ribbonized multifiber optic cable. The method is intended to be used in a system that can determine whether a group of optical fibers is correctly aligned according to a predetermined pattern, with the lowest possible level of user input. After placing a ribbon multifiber cable under a real-time camera recording, the individual frames of the video are analyzed and pre-processed. The final result of the recognition algorithm aims to automatically verify the arrangement, obtaining 94.5% accuracy.

articleTitle: Engineering Risk Analysis of Potential Outcomes and Threats of the Integration of ERP Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The modern world is changing faster and faster, and digitalisation in all its forms is taking over more and more of everyday life. In business, digitalisation manifests itself in the form of the integration of modern increasingly intelligent and large-scale ERP systems for the management of firms and companies - they allow monitoring, analysis and management of all business processes, as well as extremely serious optimization of company activities, and as a result much greater flexibility and competitiveness. These advantages and new opportunities are balanced against the high complexity and cost of ERP integration projects, as well as their high risk of failure. This puts all enterprises and companies in a serious dilemma. The purpose of this paper is to ground the different aspects of this dilemma by examining the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of ERP systems integration. To achieve the stated objective, detailed research has been conducted for the first time among business process analysts from Central and Eastern Europe who have contributed voluntarily to the results of their participation in ERP systems integration projects in small, medium and larger companies and enterprises. Based on the data obtained, a SWOT analysis has been carried out, which allows the different dimensions of the aforementioned dilemma to be outlined at an international European level.

articleTitle: Research Case Study for Hidden-Hydro
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Today’s demand for reliable, affordable, and clean energy production is greater than ever. As most suitable sites for developing major hydropower facilities are already equipped or face strong opposition due to environmental restrictions, a new concept was lately defined: Hidden Hydro. This concept refers to the untapped, latent energy present within hydraulic systems that is often overlooked or underutilized. In this context, the present paper aims to emphasize the possibilities of empowering existing dams which are not used for generating electricity and Facau reservoir, located in Arges river catchment, Romania, is considered as the case study.

articleTitle: An Economic-Oriented Model Predictive Control Framework for the Efficient Energy Operation of Wastewater Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) are highly complex large-scale plants that require substantial electrical power to operate properly; thus, the task of optimizing their operation by controlling them efficiently is a significant challenge, necessitating the use of advanced control schemes. However, the mathematical models used to simulate their dynamic behavior with high accuracy are extremely complex and cannot be utilized in the design of advanced closed-loop controllers. To this end, in this work, an economic-oriented nonlinear model predictive controller is developed by employing a reduced-order model of WWTPs, which is suitable for integration into predictive control schemes. The presented methodology aims to optimize the energy consumption during full scale operation of WWTPs, while simultaneously satisfying the strict limitations posed by specific environmental criteria. The proposed approach is compared against an alternative control scheme and the results validate its superiority in terms of reducing the energy consumption and total operational costs.

articleTitle: Centralized Parallel Computing as a Cloud Service for Solving Digital Transformation Problems in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The digital processing of geospatial data could be a significant challenge especially in automated performing of different kinds of analysis. The current computer file formats and standards for such data are oriented to expert works in specific areas, which predetermines a traditional way of working with the use of different software tools running on local PCs. Each expert or expert group is focused on specific problem solving, performing an analysis and applying the result, where the last one is required. It is quite natural at first, that a lot of state administrations, municipalities and research institutes are interested in geospatial data and GIS services, because a number of regulations and legislation forces digital transformation. In addition, the business interest in accessing and working with geospatial data is increasing in order to provide innovative products to the customers. The main aim of this paper is to illustrate a sustainable model of digital transformation by analyzing geospatial data, which combines enterprise and scientific approach to build a complex architecture, including high-performance and secure API services, signaling mechanisms and service for parallel computation, which performs given analysis with the use of GPU hardware.

articleTitle: Study of Main Traffic Parameters and Bicycle Path Suitability for Electric Vehicles and Bicycles in the City of Ruse
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The statistical reports show that the fatal traffic accidents in Bulgaria are three times greater than the leading road safety countries. As such the country is situated in one of the first places in Europe in terms of the number of people killed. Improving the road safety is vital for our country. In the Bulgarian specialized literature, there are no published results of research on the speed of electric vehicles and bicycles, as well as on the suitability of the infrastructure for these vehicles. Speed results can be very useful in the expert investigation of traffic accidents involving electric vehicles and bicycles. This paper presents the results of a study of basic parameters of electric vehicles and bicycles on the bicycle path on “Potsdam” Street in the city of Ruse. Based on the results obtained from the research, the suitability of the bicycle path can be assessed according to various criteria. The findings of this study can provide valuable background information of future research projects.

articleTitle: Clean Genetic Algorithm Architecture for Improved Modularity and Extensibility
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper delves into the potential of incorporating SOLID and clean architecture principles into the development of evolutionary algorithms, specifically focusing on a genetic algorithm. The introduced approach presents an innovative design and implementation, offering notable enhancements in extensibility and modularity, thereby contributing to improved testability and maintainability within the domain of evolutionary algorithms. The study demonstrates how the proposed design enables effortless extensions of operations within the genetic algorithm, such as parent selection, crossover, and mutation. These enhancements result from strict adherence to the SOLID and clean architecture principles. To demonstrate the practicality of this approach, the principles have been applied to a Python library called "GAdapt." This paper highlights the constructive influence of introduced concepts on the development of genetic algorithm and the improved flexibility and ease of maintenance inherent in this approach.

articleTitle: Verilog-A Model of a SAR-Based Capacitance-to-Digital Converter for Sensor Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a system-level Verilog-A model for an 8-bit successive approximation register (SAR) capacitance-to-digital converter (CDC). The Verilog-A model provides fast simulation results reducing both simulation time and computational power compared to transistor-level simulations. The model can be used in circuit simulations to capture the ideal system behavior for a suitable top-bottom design approach. The model is simulated in both time and frequency domains using Cadence Virtuoso design tool. The simulations prove the system has an SQNR of 48.9 dB and an ENOB of 7.84 bits.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Reactive Energy Flow in Public Lighting Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This article deals with investigation of negative impacts of dimmed public industrial LED light installations with new SMART components including EV charging stations on grid. This approach is required due to rise of use the new components with high impact on energy flow in public lighting systems when negative impacts on grid started to be penalized by energy distributors in significant view.

articleTitle: Electrical Control, Program Code and Experimental Studies of the Gauss Curve in a Specialized Automated Mechatronic System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The presented study aims to design an electrical control and program code and perform experimental studies of the “Gauss curve’’ in a newly designed specialized automated mechatronic system (SAMS) with flat cylindrical parts. It includes a feed hopper, a space for examination, dedicated cutoffs for part release and separation, a self-flowing magazine collector, and an automatic system for returning the examined parts to the feed hopper for a subsequent cycle. The research will be carried out using a real purpose-built SAMS prototype with flat cylindrical work details. The shape of the distribution and the type of curve to be obtained will be analyzed.

articleTitle: Designing a Laboratory for the Teaching of Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Photovoltaic systems play a very important role today in the context of renewable energy sources. Thus, the teaching of this area is now very important. Many of the schools have classical laboratories that are not especially designed for the teaching of this area. Thus, a laboratory that was especially designed for the teaching of photovoltaic systems is presented in this paper. The laboratory is prepared to test the several parts of that system, such as PV panel characteristics, MPPT, integration of storage, efficiency of the system, power profile throughout the day, etc. Supporting simulation tools such as Matlab/Simulink was also used to compare the simulation results with the experimental ones. It will also be presented the learning objectives that can be achieved with this laboratory.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis at Converting Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this paper, the specifics of the converting automobiles into electric vehicles are analyzed. Their parameters, characteristics and specific features that must be taken into account are systematized: the mass of the vehicle (only with driver and full), its frontal area and coefficient of aerodynamic resistance, the expected speed of movement according to the purpose of the vehicle; the model must be corrosion resistant and structural defects are not noticeable on the car. A comparative analysis of four automobiles to be converted to electric vehicles was carried out: Zastava 750 CE, Audi A2 L3, Skoda Fabia, Audi 80 Quattro. The required traction forces of the drive wheels are calculated at speeds from 10 km/h to 120 km/h, as well as the forces of the aerodynamic resistance and the rolling resistance. The advantages and disadvantages of each of the studied cars are determined. The most suitable automobile for conversion is selected. Suitable components of the asynchronous drive are selected for it.

articleTitle: Effects of Isopropanol Additive on Exhaust Emissions in Gasoline Engines
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The steady increase in transport needs worldwide, especially in areas with dense populations, makes it necessary to seek methods and means of using sustainable alternatives to conventional fuels to reduce the use of fossil fuels and significantly reduce environmental pollution. This study investigated the effectiveness of Isopropanol as a blend with gasoline to improve the environmental performance of internal combustion engines. Besides, as an alternative fuel isopropyl alcohol can also be considered as a renewable source of energy. Alcohols, as an alternative energy source, are considered with priority, building on their characteristics. Isopropanol, as part of the group of alcohols, has been investigated with regard to its potential to improve the mixing and combustion process and also to influence the laminar flame speed as well as the combustion rate compared to conventional gasoline in internal combustion engines. The study focused on its impact on emissions, specifically hydrocarbons, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide and nitrogen oxides. The study was carried out in a laboratory environment, on a 4-cylinder gasoline engine, for the purpose of the study gasoline and gasoline-Isopropanol mixtures were used in the ratio as follows: 95% gasoline and 5% Isopropanol (IP5), 90% gasoline and 10% Isopropanol (IP10), 85% gasoline and 15% Isopropanol (IP15) and 80% gasoline and 20% Isopropanol (IP20). Due to the properties of Isopropanol there is a reduction of HC, CO, CO2 and NOx emissions, the most favorable for this engine is the fuel mixture with Isopropanol content between 10%-15%.

articleTitle: An Overview of Silicon Carbide MOSFETs Technology with Focus on Miller Effect Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a thorough overview of silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET technology. At first, a brief market survey is conducted, focusing on modern demanding applications. In addition, the switching characteristics of SiC MOSFETs are investigated in detail. The issue of parasitic turn-on, (i.e., Miller effect) is presented and analyzed. Parameters with significant impact and mitigation methods are discussed. Finally, a comparative evaluation of various discrete MOSFETs is performed on the LTspice<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> simulation platform, regarding their performance during dv/dt transients.

articleTitle: Hysteresis Energy Caracteristic of SEGME-type in Flexible Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The object of the study are representatives of the flexible couplings of the SEGME series, designed for a nominal torque of 25 Nm and 63 Nm. The amount of energy lost in the process of internal friction is determined on the basis of an experimentally recorded dynamic characteristic of the corresponding coupling. The load and unload lines from the characteristic are described by polynomials through regression analysis. The adequacy of the selected model was evaluated. The influence of the magnitude of radial misalignment on the energy determining the coupling’s damping ability was investigated. At the same levels of radial misalignment, a study was conducted on the influence of additional angular misalignment of the joined shafts. Recommendations are made for allowable two-dimensional misalignments of the drive and driven shafts.

articleTitle: 3D Model of the Mechanical Part of a Sensor System for Collecting Data in an Agricultural Robot in a Catia Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Computer modeling is widely advocated in almost all areas of the industry. There has also been progress in the use of different 3D models in the agricultural sector, in particular in crop cultivation machines. This article attempts to design the mechanical part of an auxiliary system to an agricultural robot. This system will make it possible to extract data on the specific state of the microclimate needed to implement different approaches to crop cultivation in order to try to reduce costs and increase yields. The main attention is paid to prototyping and obtaining the three-meter digital model of the data collection structure, with a connection being the real model. An analysis of the tense state and deformations in some details of the structure has also been carried out. The created models were developed with the CATIA product of DASSOULT SYSTEMS.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Pulse Power Supply with TopSwitch TOP249YN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The operational reliability of electronic products depends directly on good design and proper selection of the electronic components used. This paper presents a reliability analysis of some of the most used power integrated circuit-based sources. The most unreliable elements are identified and replaced to improve reliability.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Electricity Prices in Hellenic Wholesale Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Nowadays the world has entered an era with energy shortages and higher prices. It is well known that Renewable Energy Sources (RES) are a real alternative to energy systems resilience, unconstrained by political uncertainties, wars or other crisis. In parallel, the Target Model in Europe represents a fundamental paradigm shift in the continent’s electricity market design, which aims at harmonizing and interconnecting the diverse national electricity markets. Hellenic Energy Exchange (HEnEx) market was established in 2020 as a result of Greece’s electricity market liberalization. This paper investigates the impact of each Greek electricity market participant on the level and volatility of electricity prices during 2022.

articleTitle: Comparative Life Cycle Assessment of Airborne Wind Energy and Horizontal Axis Wind Turbines in Türkiye
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: As the global demand for clean and sustainable energy sources continues to rise, the quest for innovative and environmentally friendly technologies becomes increasingly imperative. With growing concerns about climate change and the need to transition away from fossil fuels, understanding the environmental impacts of emerging technologies like Airborne Wind Energy (AWE) is crucial for shaping the future of energy production. This paper presents a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) of a theoretical AWE plant in Türkiye, comparing it to traditional horizontal axis wind turbines. The study aims to determine the feasibility of installing AWE plants in Türkiye and their environmental impact. Results show that AWE plants use less material and generate electricity with lower impacts than traditional turbines, making them a viable option for renewable energy generation in Türkiye.

articleTitle: Modelling and Characteristics of the Car Emergency Braking Process at Low Frequency Data Logging
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The movement of transport vehicles in urban environment is carried out at relatively low speeds and mainly at transient modes of operation of the engines. Kinematic parameters during movement change in relatively narrow dynamic ranges, except for processes during emergency braking. For their research, especially for two-wheeled vehicles, compact devices designed for quick mounting are often used. The conducted research shows that with inappropriate technical characteristics and insufficient frequency of registration of the position of the vehicle, significant deviations from the actual values can be generated. When analyzing the process of emergency braking and especially when studying the period of increase of the braking deceleration to maximum value, it is necessary to determine the requirements for the technical parameters of the device used.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Angular Speed Estimation using Acoustic Emission in Gas Foil Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The instantaneous angular speed (IAS) is a vital state variable of rotating systems, giving insight into the current function of the system and valuable information for condition monitoring algorithms. In this work, we demonstrate that it is possible to estimate the rotor’s IAS from acoustic emission signals (AE) recorded in a gas foil bearing. To do so, we record AE, acceleration, and a reference IAS simultaneously before applying two IAS estimation methods to both signals. Their results are then compared to the reference and among each other. The estimated IAS based on the AE envelope signal was slightly more accurate than the results based on the typically used acceleration signal. However, subharmonic vibrations, which often cause difficulties estimating the IAS, were also more prevalent in the AE envelope. These findings suggest that AE-based algorithms may be able to estimate the IAS from their underlying data without additional sensors in the future.

articleTitle: Development of Cyber Ranges as a Reference Environment for Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In the last few years, the expansion of information technology in more and more activities is evident and attracting high attention. The improvement of big data processing and the growth of artificial intelligence are the foundations of these processes. However, Cyber security is a lagging element of this technological evolution. Proof of this is the increased Cybercrimes levels for the past year 2022 compared to previous years. To accelerate the resolution of this issue, the study examines the development and use of Cyber range as a major component of the efforts in enhancing Cyber resilience. The different types of solutions in the field, their advantages and disadvantages are considered. The role of Cyber Ranges as a core component of Cyber security endeavor that enables all kinds of research and testing of real-world systems and uncovering their weaknesses. As in recent years, Cyber ranges are establishing themselves as an important tool for training and enhancing the knowledge and skills of Cybersecurity experts. The overview analysis on the topic also draws attention to the benefits of consolidating Cyber polygons as a global service.

articleTitle: Application of Object Detection Algorithm on SoC-FPGA using OpenCL
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Nowadays, object detection algorithms have been widely applied in various aspects of life. However, along with the advancement of these algorithms comes high computational complexity, which requires significant processing time. One approach to reduce processing time is to enhance computational speed by implementing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). However, using FPGAs presents a challenge, as it requires hardware description languages to design complex CNNs, which can be time-consuming. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a novel hardware design approach leveraging the Intel® FPGA SDK (Software Development Kit) for $\mathrm{O}\mathrm{p}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{n}\mathrm{C}\mathrm{L}^{\mathrm{T}\mathrm{M}}$ to implement hardware using the C language with the OpenCL framework. This approach involves implementing a CNN on the DE1-SoC board specifically for object detection tasks.

articleTitle: Virtual Model and Validation of Gas Turbines Control System for Simulation of Dynamic Stability with Power Factory
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The mathematical models of gas turbines used for simulations of dynamic stability in electrical industry employ reduced dynamics and controls standardized by the literature. This study incorporates additional process parameters, such as compressor pressure, ambient temperature, and control algorithms from the MARK-V system for generating units GCH09 and GCHIO of the Guaracachi Plant (Sant Cruz, Bolivia). The validity of these models is demonstrated by comparing simulation results with real events from the National Interconnected System (SIN) under the criteria established in the current Minimum Performance Conditions (CDM) of the SIN.

articleTitle: Consideration and Specifics for 3D Printed Coil Formers for Power Magnetics
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a short overview of considerations and specifics related to 3D printing of coilformers for power electronics magnetics. Major standards that manage coilformer production and properties are discussed. Specifics to the 3D printing of the coilformers are presented. An example of producing a coilformer with controlled parameters used for a transformer for an LLC converter is provided. The results from this test show that using 3D printing to control the geometry of the coilformer allows for fine adjustment of the leakage inductance of the transformer.

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbance Detection using Autoencoder Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Power Quality is a vast and critical field of study in the power system dealing with the conformance of the sinusoidal current and voltage waveforms with the healthy nominal system requirements as governed by local and international standards. Power Quality Disturbances (PQD) are aberrations in the voltage and current waveforms under question and thus their existence has a pernicious effect on all the loads feeding on the grid. Thus, monitoring and measuring devices in large scale power systems produce large amounts of time series data which facilitates the need to develop algorithms that can quickly analyze and detect power quality disturbances to apply and develop the appropriate measures to avoid long term detrimental outcomes to consumers and added costs onto the grid operators. Therefore, this paper proposes an anomaly detection approach using an autoencoder neural network tested on odd harmonics, voltage sag and voltage swell as well as their combination in a sample power system signal.

articleTitle: Preliminary Readiness Toward Digital Twin and Smart Digital Ecosystem of a Large Production Company
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper makes the case for the future of innovation in the context of the Digital Twins. Transformation to new technologies is a phenomenon that impacts on innovations in all sectors of the economy. It has enabled the creation of completely new digital products and services and the enhancement of traditional ones with digital features. Production processes are also change, with new modes of human-to-machine interaction. Application of new technologies including Digital Twins requires innovations and preliminary readiness. Predictive maintenance, new product design, internal and external cooperation, new opportunities for business and production are some of DT advantages. The main objective of the report is to examine the pre-readiness of a large enterprise and the firms in its ecosystem to participate in a digital ecosystem and its digital twin. The study goes through the following stages: formulation of the concept of "digital twin" in the context of the present study; theoretical exploration of the relationship between innovation and digital twins; theoretical exploration of the benefit of digital twins; a study of the pre-readiness to incorporate a large firm and its ecosystem of firms into a digital ecosystem and into a digital twin. The pre-readiness of a large enterprise and the firms in its ecosystem to participate in a digital ecosystem and a digital twin is investigated and the following challenges were identified: missing strategy for overcoming changes; missing necessary skills, knowledge, and experience; continuous development of customer needs; opposition to change inside the company; security considerations; financial pressure; maintaining and working with old systems.

articleTitle: Failures Analysis of Devices in Signaling Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Over a three-year period after the commissioning of a section with six metro stations of the first diameter, the failures of devices from the safety equipment were registered. The data has been selected and analyzed according to the type of cause of failure for the various devices (separately for traffic lights, rail circuits, point machines). Based on the statistical processing of the information on the failures, a calculation of the reliability indicators of the devices is carried out using a proposed methodology. The obtained results conclusively prove the need for reliability analysis and determination of equipment reliability indicators. Statistical processing of failure information does not give a complete presentation of reliability, as it does not take into account a number of additional factors. Complex indicators as Comprehensive uptime and Maintainability (indices of Availability and Unavailability) are the most accurate assessment of the reliability of a given device.

articleTitle: Real-time Observation of Earthquake Disaster Zones with Wireless Sensor Networks-based Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Earthquakes are a dangerous natural hazard causing a lot of damages in human life. It is well-known that earthquakes can occur at any time and an early prediction of such an earthquake is often very difficult or impossible. This brings the necessity to prepare the requirements after the occurrence of an earthquake in a particular zone. Real-time observation of earthquake areas faces several serious problems, such as communication infrastructure becomes useless. Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) based solutions can offer a great opportunity in observing a disaster area, thanks to their ability of self-organization in detecting an environmental information to be reported to a remote center. With the utilization of small drones to collect the information from WSNs, an earthquake zone can be efficiently controlled and monitored. This paper aims to present a main architecture of a real-time observation system with WSNs and drones. To make the proposed architecture more efficient and intelligent, state-of-the-art approaches in terms of medium access control (MAC) will be introduced and a discussion is carried out to integrate MAC approaches with the proposed mechanism. It is highly believed that this paper will give a clear guidance for future researchers to focus on efficient solutions for detecting and preventing the negative impacts of the earthquakes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Alumni Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Alumni is a vital sector for every higher education institution, which comes to the aid of students in their post-graduation journey. An Alumni information system helps students to identify opportunities that reflect their interests, skills and aspirations, as well as help them to develop their potential and careers. This paper presents the design and development of an Alumni information system for Aleksander Moisiu University (UAMD), which aims to effectively and quickly manage the data of graduated students, their updating and their access by stakeholders. The system will be organized in a software that will be used to add data from the Alumni staff and from a Website which, interactively offers services both to employing companies and to job-seeking students. This paper contributes to the development and digitalization of the Alumni sector and in particular contributes to the development and digitalization of the Alumni sector in UAMD.
